template_title: Certificate for Admissibility of Electronic Records under Section 63(4) BSA

clauses.clause_text: I certify that during the period [PERIOD], the computer device [DEVICE IDENTIFIER] was operating properly and under my lawful official control.
clauses.statutory_rationale: Mandated by Section 63(4)(a) of Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

clauses.clause_text: The contents of this certificate are true to the best of my knowledge and belief.
clauses.statutory_rationale: Mandatory solemn declaration required for evidentiary admissibility.

full_draft_template:
I, [NAME OF RESPONSIBLE OFFICER], son/daughter of [PARENT NAME], aged [AGE], residing at [ADDRESS], do hereby solemnly certify under Section 63(4) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023:
1. That I am the in-charge of [COMPUTER/SERVER] located at [LOCATION].
2. That the electronic record [FILE NAME/HASH] was generated in regular course.
Date: [DATE]
Signature: [SIGNATURE]

evidence_passages.verbatim_text: Provided that where any electronic record is produced in evidence, it shall be accompanied by a certificate referred to in sub-section (4) of section 63.

template_title: Application for Admissibility of Electronic Records under Section 63(1) BSA
statutory_basis: Section 63 of the Information Technology (Adoption of Indian Standards for Electronic Records) Adhiniyam, 2023

clauses.clause_text: To the Honorable Court, I, [DEPONENT NAME], submit this application for the admissibility of electronic records under Section 63(1) of the Information Technology (Adoption of Indian Standards for Electronic Records) Adhiniyam, 2023.
clauses.statutory_rationale: Mandated by Section 63(1) of the Information Technology (Adoption of Indian Standards for Electronic Records) Adhiniyam, 2023.

clauses.clause_text: The electronic records in question are [BRIEFLY DESCRIBE THE ELECTRONIC RECORDS]. These records were produced by the computer during the period from [DATE] to [DATE].
clauses.statutory_rationale: Mandated by Section 63(2)(a) of the Information Technology (Adoption of Indian Standards for Electronic Records) Adhiniyam, 2023.

clauses.clause_text: I, [DEPONENT NAME], hereby certify that the computer output containing the information was produced by the computer during the period over which the computer was used regularly, and that information of the kind contained in the electronic record was regularly fed into the computer. [DEPONENT SIGNATURE]
clauses.statutory_rationale: Mandated by Section 63(2)(b) of the Information Technology (Adoption of Indian Standards for Electronic Records) Adhiniyam, 2023.

full_draft_template:
To the Honorable Court, I, [DEPONENT NAME], submit this application for the admissibility of electronic records under Section 63(1) of the Information Technology (Adoption of Indian Standards for Electronic Records) Adhiniyam, 2023.

The electronic records in question are [BRIEFLY DESCRIBE THE ELECTRONIC RECORDS]. These records were produced by the computer during the period from [DATE] to [DATE].

I, [DEPONENT NAME], hereby certify that the computer output containing the information was produced by the computer during the period over which the computer was used regularly, and that information of the kind contained in the electronic record was regularly fed into the computer. [DEPONENT SIGNATURE]

Respectfully submitted,
[DEPONENT NAME]
[DEPONENT ADDRESS]
[DEPONENT PHONE NUMBER]
[DEPONENT EMAIL]
drafting_pitfalls_to_avoid: Failure to provide sufficient details about the electronic records
